title: Ruins of the Earth
description: A secret buried in the Antarctic. A puzzle unsolved for thousands of years. And a Brooklyn-born Master Gunnery Sergeant who's royally pissed that he has to babysit the researchers sent to figure it all out. Patrick "Wic" Finnegan's last op as a Marine Raider before retirement sends him to the frozen Ellsworth Subglacial Highlands. The only reason he's here? He owes a favor to an old friend—but that doesn't mean he has to like it. When Wic finally sees what the team has uncovered, he can't believe his eyes, nor is he prepared for the violence to come. Soon, the portal opens and unleashes a storm of unbridled fury upon humanity. From the Antarctic tundra to the streets of Manhattan, Wic and his team will be pushed to their limits as they fight to hold back Earth's ultimate threat. The odds are against them. Governments are toppling. And the Earth is falling into ruin. Join bestselling authors Christopher Hopper and J.N. Chaney on what readers call a "non-stop, break-neck thrill ride into metaspace." For fans of District 9, Expeditionary Force, and Galaxy's Edge, this is one military sci-fi thriller you won't be able to put down, and the official prequel to the hit series Ruins of the Galaxy.  if(window.mix_csa){window.mix_csa('[cel_widget_id="tell-amazon-desktop_DetailPage_5"]', '#CardInstanceSCy7R_k26z4ubwZSje4-ag')('mark', 'bb')} if(window.uet){window.uet('bb','tell-amazon-desktop_DetailPage_5',{wb: 1})} ._tell-amazon-desktop_style_tell_amazon_icon_core_report__Fs1ah{color:#0f1111;color:var(--aok-sfs-color-page-primary-normal-fg,#0f1111);display:inline-block;-webkit-filter:none;filter:none;-webkit-filter:var(--aok-sfs-effect-mode-dark-color-silhouette-white,none);filter:var(--aok-sfs-effect-mode-dark-color-silhouette-white,none);height:20px;margin-right:4px;width:20px}.

title: Aftermath Whispers of a Ruined World: Survival Narratives from a Ravaged Earth
description: In a future where the Earth's splendor is but a fading memory, Aftermath Whispers of a Ruined World paints a hauntingly vivid picture of survival and resilience. The remnants of humanity are scattered across a desolate landscape, their lives marked by the echoes of a world that once was. The story follows three protagonists whose paths intersect in the most unlikely of places—a crumbling city where nature is reclaiming its dominion. There’s Elara, a fiercely independent scavenger with a mysterious past; Aiden, a former scientist burdened with the guilt of his role in the planet's downfall; and Lyra, a young girl whose dreams are filled with visions of a world she never knew. Together, they embark on a journey to uncover the truth behind the cataclysm that shattered their world and to find a glimmer of hope amidst the ruins. As they navigate through treacherous territories, from eerie ghost towns to lush forests overtaken by mutated flora and fauna, they encounter other survivors—each with their own stories of loss and endurance. The whispers of the past guide them, revealing secrets that challenge everything they believed about their world's destruction. Aftermath Whispers of a Ruined World is a gripping tale of human spirit and the unyielding quest for redemption. With richly detailed settings and complex characters, this dystopian narrative explores themes of survival, the consequences of human actions, and the fragile thread of hope that can emerge even in the darkest of times. In this evocative novel, every whisper carries a story, every ruin hides a history, and every step forward is a testament to humanity's undying will to rebuild and rediscover what it means to be alive.  if(window.mix_csa){window.mix_csa('[cel_widget_id="tell-amazon-desktop_DetailPage_6"]', '#C

title: Zombie Harvest:Dead Earth Rising: Book 1 A Post-Apocalyptic Zombie Survival Novel of Waste
description: The Gray Plague came on a Tuesday. By Friday, the world had stopped pretending it was going to be all right. It was not missiles that ended civilization. It was not fire. It was a whisper in the soil — a gray rot creeping up through the roots of things, turning green fields to ash and living men to shambling, hungry things that only understood one word. Heh-heh-heh. The dead don't negotiate. They only eat. Caleb Mercer is not a soldier. He is a plant geneticist — the last one standing, as far as he knows — who inherited a seed his dying grandmother swore would matter "when the dead earth won't produce anything." He filed it under the ramblings of an old woman. Then the dead came, the fields died, the grocery stores became feeding grounds, and the seed cracked open in his blood — binding him to a living network of golden wheat, healing fruit, and thorn hedges that strangle whole hordes and use them for fertilizer. Dead earth, living seed. That is the engine of this series. The Gray Plague is a death-spore: it poisons soil, water, and air, and it turns every granary into a tomb. Nobody thought to plant a garden. Caleb Mercer did. In the ruins of an abandoned highway town called Hollowbrook, he builds the first wall of living green — a thorn hedge that grows overnight, kills on contact, and feeds on the dead it catches. He grows food where nothing should grow: golden wheat that revives poisoned soil, healing fruit that breaks fever and staves off the spore, water-filtering reeds that make the gray water drinkable, spore-flowers that carve clean zones out of the deadly air. Book 1 of the Zombie Harvest Saga, Dead Earth Rising, is the origin story of that green wall — and of the war it starts. title: Prison of the Dominion - Book 3 of 4 (A Dystopian Post-Apocalyptic Dragon Fantasy): The Ga
description: Gabe survived the Dragon Games once. To save his mother, he may have to enter them again. Gabe and Squawk are racing west across Gamma Earth, chasing the one thing Gabe never expected to find in the wasteland—hope. His mother may still be alive. Their search leads them through marauders, mutants, and the ruins of the old world until Gabe and his growing dragon find refuge inside a fortified Las Vegas compound. There, hope becomes a nightmare. Gabe's mother is alive. And the Dominion has her. Gabe is ready to tear his way through anything standing between them, but rescuing her will require allies. To earn their trust, Gabe and Squawk must prove themselves the only way this brutal world understands. In the Games. Again. But Squawk is no longer the little dragon Gabe first bonded with. He's growing stronger, their connection is deepening, and together they're becoming something the Dominion can no longer afford to ignore. Because Gabe isn't running anymore. This time, he's coming for someone they took from him. The Dominion murdered his father, and now they have his mother. He has spent long enough running from the Dominion. Now he’s coming for what they took.  if(window.mix_csa){window.mix_csa('[cel_widget_id="tell-amazon-desktop_DetailPage_3"]', '#CardInstancepJPDavk0eB85gqmRLUGGog')('mark', 'bb')} if(window.uet){window.uet('bb','tell-amazon-desktop_DetailPage_3',{wb: 1})} ._tell-amazon-desktop_style_tell_amazon_icon_core_report__Fs1ah{color:#0f1111;color:var(--aok-sfs-color-page-primary-normal-fg,#0f1111);display:inline-block;-webkit-filter:none;filter:none;-webkit-filter:var(--aok-sfs-effect-mode-dark-color-silhouette-white,none);filter:var(--aok-sfs-effect-mode-dark-color-silhouette-white,none);height:20px;margin-right:4px;width:20px}._tell-amazon-desktop_style_tell_

title: Earth Fall: To the Stars: (Book Two)
description: From USA Today Bestselling author of The Slaver Wars comes a new military science fiction series. In a desperate battle, Earth has temporarily freed itself from the clutches of the deadly Trellixian Empire. Billions are dead and it’s only a matter of time before the enemy return. Seeking aid against the Trellixians, two exploration ships are sent out to search the galaxy for allies. If they fail, then the Human race is doomed. The Trellixians need Earth to colonize to help relieve the growing population pressure of their overcrowded home worlds. The Trellixians will not rest until every Human is dead and the Earth is theirs. On Earth, General Mitchell and Fleet Admiral Edwards prepare to fight their biggest battle. Every man and woman is being trained to use a weapon.
